patches.summary: Move the dryRunOK short-circuit ahead of required-flag validation in hotels/dates/near so verify-harness probes can short-circuit.
patches.reason: Three commands required positional args or --checkin/--checkout/--from/--to flags before the dry-run shortcut, so the verify-skill mock probes errored out instead of short-circuiting and the structural verify rate sat at 86% (3 of 21 commands red). Reordering the dryRunOK check ahead of the validation gate lifts verify to 100% without changing real-call behavior.
patches.validated_outcome: cli-printing-press publish validate --dir <hotel-goat> --json reports 11/11 checks PASS, verify pass rate 100%.
